name: gelato
description: Device access SDKs for applications that see and act

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:model-plugins && npm run build:device-ui && npm run check:examples
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace @gelato/model-interface && npm run build --workspace @gelato/server-core && npm run build --workspace @gelato/server-android && npm run build --workspace @gelato/server-ios && npm run build --workspace @gelato/control-room
scripts.build:device-ui: npm run build --workspace @gelato/device-app && npm run sync --workspace @gelato/device-app
